global_feedback_coverage.semantics: Only the selected285 global learning records, grouped by issue time before/after9000; missing metadata is null, observed absence is zero. Separate physical diagnostic labels do not enter these counts.

global_context_family_decomposition.semantics: Secondary all-after comparison on identical saved predictions; the fixed family is A2's issue-time selection, never the best family after observing truth.

physical.periods: before6k–9k; early9k–12k; late15k–18k; all_after combines early/middle/late, excludes crossing. Coverage retains crossing/drain separately. Bias is predicted minus actual; bias deltas are signed, not an improvement score.

matched_trip_shock_effects.semantics: One frozen_source_prior log per real direct interval; matched by line/trip/vehicle and assigned by shock interval period. Nonholding includes motion/signals/next-stop service, not pure speed. Stable-only trajectories have no shock period and remain outside these period means.

source_calibration.semantics: same-trip decision-ready to next-stop decision-ready; holding plus motion/signals plus service

interpretation: Each contrast uses up to five paired seeds in the listed seed order; 95% paired t intervals are unadjusted. Missing values remain null. Absolute shock cost must accompany shock-minus-stable excess. No early degradation is distinct from right censoring. TD telemetry samples the first update of57 packets; actor_updated covers all456 updates and action changes cover each packet's8 updates. TD model/real batch means are unpaired. Local interval context is distinct from global A3 context.
